cause: Architecture review identified cross-view loading, floating-layout, collapse, persistence, error-state, and server-save response gaps in the Report review workspace.

evidence.ref: Graph to Report, Float to Table, collapse, reload persistence

impact: A floating Report review could lose its in-flight report, leave a blank right column, remain oversized after collapse, outrank modal surfaces, lose layout state on reload, or mislabel load failures as an empty report.
lesson: Cross-view workspace panels need explicit async lifetime, zero-width dock behavior, persisted UI state, modal-aware stacking, and distinct load-error states before browser acceptance.
